title: Uzabase Acquires Sealed Network to Expand Southeast Asia Expert Network Capabilities
summary: Carlyle-owned Uzabase acquired Singapore-based Sealed Network, a Southeast Asia-specialized expert network, continuing its expert network expansion strategy following Mimir subsidiary conversion (2020) and Enquire AI asset acquisition (2024). The deal strengthens Uzabase's APAC capabilities. Note: Uzabase published the announcement with a URL dated Dec. 19, 2025, though the global press-release page shows Dec. 22, 2025; this entry uses the URL-embedded date.
whyItMatters: Uzabase's acquisition of Sealed Network extends the trend of media intelligence firms expanding into expert networks.
